issues.problem: Distractor 飲んでも is not plainly wrong: 少し飲んでも、いつも顔が赤くなります ('even a little and he always goes red') is natural and fits the English 'after just a little'.
issues.action: Replaced 飲[の]んでも with 飲[の]む前[まえ]に (clearly contradicts 'after'); updated why.

issues.problem: eval value ありがたいです rendered as 'the more welcome it is', which breaks agreement with plural items (the plane tickets, the vegetables).
issues.action: Changed English to 'the more grateful they are' (subject is the <who> group, plural for every value).
